description: This file defines a controller class for the 'SaleShipping' report in the OpenCart admin extension. It includes methods for displaying the report form, saving configurations, listing reports, and generating report data, such as shipping orders over a period with filtering and pagination.

classes.name: SaleShipping
classes.description: Controller class managing the sale shipping report in the OpenCart admin panel. Handles display, configuration, and report data retrieval.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the report configuration form in the admin panel.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the report configuration settings and filters submitted via POST.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generates and displays the report page, including fetching report data and pagination.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a JSON response with the report data list.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves report data based on request filters, including date range, grouping, and order status, and formats the output.
